create_jax_friendly_dataclass: create a JAX-friendly dataclass using chex.dataclass decorator with frozen and mappable options
make_dataclass_mappable: make a Python dataclass implement the Mapping interface using mappable_dataclass function
register_dataclass_with_jax: register an existing dataclass with JAX tree utilities using register_dataclass_type_with_jax_tree_util
flatten_dataclass_for_jax: flatten a chex dataclass into a tuple representation for JAX tree operations
replace_dataclass_fields: replace specific fields in a frozen chex dataclass using the replace method
